suppress.notes: AppAuth is a native OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect client, not the historical OpenID server/product identified by this CPE. Dependency-Check associates CVE-2007-1651 (and the related historical OpenID match) with the exact AppAuth PURL. Scope this correction to the OpenID CPE on AppAuth only.

CVE-2008-0986 targets the BMP parser in obsolete libsgl.so shipped in early Android SDK preview releases, not the modern Google Play Services measurement SDK. This product-identity mismatch is limited to these two exact measurement artifact names.

CVE-2008-3891 applies to the Google Apps SAML Single Sign-On service. The matched artifact is Google Play Services App Set ID SDK, a different product and attack surface. Suppressed only for this exact PURL/CVE pair.
CVE-2012-2055 is a GitHub Enterprise mass-assignment issue. The detector maps it to Glide disklrucache, gifdecoder and core artifacts via an unrelated GitHub CPE. This is not a Glide vulnerability.

CVE-2026-53914 affects the Kotlin Gradle plugin build-cache metadata deserializer, not Kotlin runtime libraries shipped in the app. The Kotlin Gradle plugin is upgraded to 2.4.21 and separately asserted on the build-logic compile classpath in security.yml. This rule is limited to the runtime stdlib/parcelize PURLs reported by the app runtime scan.

The reported 2.7.0 version is the AndroidX SQLite library release, not the upstream SQLite engine version. The sqlite-framework artifact implements AndroidX interfaces through Android framework APIs; these PURLs are not the separately bundled SQLite engine. Suppress only the upstream SQLite CPE on these exact AndroidX artifacts.

androidx.browser:browser is the AndroidX Custom Tabs support library. The matched CPE is the unrelated historical Android Browser product. Limit this product-name correction to the AndroidX Browser PURL.
CameraX Lifecycle is an AndroidX lifecycle integration library. The matched Camera Life CPE identifies an unrelated photo-hosting product.
CameraX Video is an AndroidX camera recording library. CVE-2015-3362 identifies the Drupal Video module, not AndroidX CameraX Video.

kotlinx-coroutines-play-services is the Kotlin Coroutines adapter for Google Play Services Task APIs. The Tasks CPE identifies the unrelated Tasks.org Android to-do application; this match is limited to that CPE on this exact Maven artifact.

CVE-2026-54285 affects the OpenTelemetry JavaScript Node.js client (@opentelemetry/core), not the OpenTelemetry Java API, common or context artifacts. Suppress only the Node.js CPE for these Java Maven PURLs.

The report assigns the nested scotty-minified.jar the Firebase Crashlytics PURL (21.1.0) and infers a Guava CPE from low-confidence product-name evidence; 21.1.0 is the Crashlytics version, not a Guava version. The app's separately resolved com.google.guava:guava dependency is 33.7.1-jre (Android jar variant) and is guarded by an app-level minimum version constraint plus a CI dependencyInsight check for both release variants. This suppression applies only to the Guava CPE on this exact Crashlytics PURL. Genuine com.google.guava:guava package findings remain in scope and are not suppressed.
